title: Finite modules over a regular local ring have bounded projective resolutions
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] of Krull dimension $d$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Every finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] has a projective resolution of length at most $d$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00O7, proof of the first assertion (lines 26934--26938)

proof.text: ($R$ has an $R$-regular sequence of length $d$ in $\mathfrak m$.) By definition [def-weil-regular-scheme] $R$ is a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of finite Krull dimension $d$ whose maximal ideal is generated by $d$ elements $x_1,\dots,x_d$. By [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-generators-regular-sequence] (Stacks 00NQ) $x_1,\dots,x_d$ is an $R$-regular sequence in $\mathfrak m$. Since $\mathfrak mR=\mathfrak m\ne R$, the definition of depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] gives $\operatorname{depth}(R)\ge d$. So $R$ satisfies the hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-cm-local-free-resolution-to-mcm] (it is Cohen–Macaulay, which is how Stacks applies Lemma 00NG to a regular local ring).

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00O7 (proposition-regular-finite-gl-dim, line 26922), proof lines 26934-26938; Lemma Tag 00NQ (lemma-regular-ring-CM)

proof.text: (Resolution ending in $K$.) Let $M$ be a nonzero finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $e=\operatorname{depth}(M)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-cm-local-free-resolution-to-mcm] (Stacks 00NG), applicable by Step 1, $e\le d$ and there is an exact sequence $0\to K\to F_{d-e-1}\to\cdots\to F_0\to M\to0$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] with every $F_i$ finite free and $K$ a finite $R$-module which is $0$ or satisfies $\operatorname{depth}(K)=d$ (for $e=d$: $0\to K\to M\to0$, so $K\cong M$).

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00O7 (proposition-regular-finite-gl-dim, line 26922), proof lines 26934-26938: 'The first part holds in view of Lemma regular-mcm-free and Lemma mcm-resolution'; Lemma Tag 00NG (lemma-mcm-resolution, line 25411)

proof.text: ($K$ is free.) If $K=0$ it is free of rank $0$. Otherwise $K$ is a finite $R$-module with $\operatorname{depth}(K)=d=\dim R$, i.e. maximal Cohen–Macaulay, and $R$ is regular local of dimension $d$, so $K\cong R^{\oplus r}$ is free by [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-mcm-free] (Stacks 00NT). Hence $0\to K\to F_{d-e-1}\to\cdots\to F_0\to M\to0$ is a finite free resolution of $M$ of length $d-e$, which is the first assertion of Stacks 00O7.

source.place: Algebra, Proposition Tag 00O7 (proposition-regular-finite-gl-dim, line 26922), proof lines 26934-26938; Lemma Tag 00NT (lemma-regular-mcm-free, line 25800)

proof.text: (Every finite module has a projective resolution of length $\le d$.) A free module $R^{\oplus r}$ is a direct summand of a free module (itself), hence projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. So for $M\ne0$, setting $P_{d-e}=K$ and $P_i=F_i$ for $0\le i<d-e$ (for $e=d$: $P_0=K\cong M$), Step 3 gives a projective resolution $0\to P_{d-e}\to\cdots\to P_0\to M\to0$ of length $\le d-e$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]; since $0\le d-e\le d$ (Step 2: $e\le d$; $e\ge0$), putting $P_i=0$ for $d-e<i\le d$ gives one of length $\le d$ by [lem-weil-pbc-projective-dimension-well-defined] (1). For $M=0$, the sequence with all $P_i=0$ is a projective resolution of length $\le d$. So every finite $R$-module has a projective resolution of length $\le d$.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteModule_hasProjectiveResolutionLE
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, Module.Finite R M →
      ModuleCat.HasProjectiveResolutionLE M d
